Follow the repository instructions in .github/copilot-instructions.md.

Execute the complete task directly as the current agent. Do not delegate, orchestrate, spawn, or request work from subagents, custom agents, or other sessions.

Use the available read, search, edit, and execute tools to inspect the repository, implement the requested changes, validate them with the repository's defined scripts, and report the final result.
